channel.title: Avhishek: credit card news and offers
channel.description: Indian credit card news, devaluations, bank changes and offers, each linked to its source.

item.title: OneCard Festive Bonanza gives extra 2.5% valueback on spends
item.description: Selected OneCard users get an extra 2.5% valueback on total eligible spends from 25 to 31 October 2026 after a personalised spend target (₹50,000 here). Capped at 15,000 points (₹1,500), credited on 15 December 2026. Validity: 25 Oct 2026 to 31 Oct 2026, 11:59 pm IST.

item.title: HDFC Tata Neu credit cards: NeuCoins must be claimed by hand from 25 November 2026, or they expire
item.description: From 25 November 2026, NeuCoins earned on Tata Neu HDFC Bank credit cards stop moving to Tata Neu automatically. Claim them in the Tata Neu app (minimum 100, up to 3 claims a day) within 12 months of the statement, or they expire.

item.title: PNB credit card charges rise from 1 November 2026: utility fee, ₹99 redemption fee, higher late fees
item.description: From 1 November 2026, PNB charges 1% on utility payments above ₹50,000 a cycle, ₹99 + GST per reward redemption, and late fees of up to ₹1,200 (was ₹750). Applies to PNB Visa and RuPay cards.

item.title: PNB credit cards give up to ₹1,500 cashback for Navratri and Dussehra
item.description: Make at least 3 transactions of ₹9,999 on a PNB credit card between 11 and 20 October 2026 to get cashback of up to ₹1,500, once per card. Co-branded cards are excluded. Validity: 11 Oct 2026 to 20 Oct 2026, 11:59 pm IST.

item.title: Slice Business Credit Card launches in December 2026
item.description: Slice’s business card for sole proprietors is due in December 2026. Pre-launch material promises no annual fee, up to 2% cashback and zero forex markup; the full terms aren’t out yet.
